description: CAMS recall eval cases. Copy to eval/cases.json and replace with questions about YOUR project, phrased the way an agent would ask them. `ids` = decision/task ids a good answer must contain (strict hit); `phrases` = distinctive text from the answer (lenient hit if no id matches). Optional `sources` restricts the search like cams_query's `sources`. Add a case for every real miss (cams_feedback 'missed', `npm run report`). Aim for 40+ cases, a few of them answered only by uncurated sources (session logs) so a source boost can't look better than it is.

cases.q: Which sprint covers observability and alerting?
Why did we choose this database?
How did we fix the build error in the shared package?
cases.note: answer lives in a session log, not a curated source
